name: Endless City
source:
You play as Urbs, the god of the city, who is given the task to find someone fitting a certain description: It must be a human being whose body lives in the present, but whose soul is already in the future.  Someone empathetic and ready for big changes. However, the task turns out to be a harbinger of great danger.

[From [url=https://weirdrat.itch.io/endless-city]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演城市之神乌布斯，他的任务是找到符合某种描述的人：必须是一个身体活在当下，但灵魂已经在未来的人。  一个有同理心并准备好迎接重大改变的人。 然而，这项任务却预示着巨大的危险。

[来自[url=https://weirdrat.itch.io/endless-city]Itch.io[/url]]
